title: Nusrat Shah's Reign
subtitle: Late Husain Shahi governance and regional diplomacy.
summary: Under Nusrat Shah, Bengal maintained a significant regional profile through court governance, diplomacy, and continuity of the Husain Shahi political order.
heroTagline: Late Husain Shahi governance and regional diplomacy.
